cases.name: all_commands
cases.expectation: CREATE_QUEUE, SEND, FETCH, ACK and DELETE_QUEUE succeed with correlated responses

cases.name: ambiguous_retry
cases.expectation: a lost response followed by the exact authenticated request returns the recorded response without duplicate state

cases.name: redelivery
cases.expectation: FETCH before ACK redelivers the same current message

cases.name: authentication_failure
cases.expectation: tampered authentication returns AUTH_INVALID without mutation

cases.name: malformed_frame
cases.expectation: forbidden or truncated CBOR returns MALFORMED_FRAME

cases.name: unknown_version
cases.expectation: a v1 peer returns a readable v1 UNSUPPORTED_VERSION response without decoding the unknown payload

cases.name: durable_restart
cases.expectation: accepted messages and delivery state remain observable after relay restart

cases.name: message_reordering
cases.expectation: two accepted messages are fetched and acknowledged in their committed order

previous_version.reason: Queue v1 is the first registered version; spec/10-versioning.md registers no supported predecessor.
